steps.title: Prepare Synchronized Worms
steps.instruction: Perform bleach synchronization of C. elegans following the Ida Barlow protocol, ensuring the pellet is remixed after each wash.

steps.title: Prepare Drug Source Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare drug source plates in skirted 96-well plates such that each column corresponds to a single drug at a single concentration, with a final DMSO concentration of 0.1%.

substeps.instruction: Use VIAFLO to fill 30 x SOURCE plates with 7 µL water and 0.5 µL drug from STOCK plates.

steps.title: Label Destination Plates
steps.instruction: Label each DESTINATION plate with the source plate and the corresponding DESTINATION SLOT in the Opentrons robot.

steps.title: Execute Opentrons Robot Protocol
steps.instruction: Run the Opentrons robot protocol to randomize column locations from source plates to destination plates using the date as the random seed.

substeps.instruction: Ensure one drug source plate is used with a multichannel pipette (each column corresponding to a drug).
Monitor the robot to ensure all tips are removed.
Replace tip racks after each destination plate is filled.

steps.title: Seed Drug Plates with OP50
steps.instruction: Dispense 5 µL of 1:10 diluted OP50 into each well of each drug plate using a VIAFILL dispenser.

substeps.instruction: Allow to dry for 30 minutes under the flow hood.
Keep at room temperature overnight, covered in the dark.

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Worms
steps.instruction: Wash worms off 150mm plates with M9 using a pasteur pipette into 15ml falcons.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 1500 rpm (ascending 9, descending 7) for 2 minutes to pellet the worms.
Remove supernatant and fill with M9.
Repeat the spin and wash steps two more times.

steps.title: Prepare Worm Suspension
steps.instruction: After the final wash, fill the falcon with M9 and transfer contents of 15mL falcons to 50mL falcons, filling up to 45mL with M9.

steps.title: Drug Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate worms in drug for 4 hours.

substeps.instruction: Allow liquid to dry off the plates for 30 mins under the flow hood prior to/during process.

steps.title: Day 1 Tracking Setup
steps.instruction: Pick L4 worms onto 4 x OP50-seeded NGM 90mm plates (10 worms per plate).

substeps.instruction: At 17:00, refeed L1s onto 5 x 150mm plates by dropping 4 small droplets around the edges of the plate (off food).

steps.title: Day 2 Tracking Setup
steps.instruction: Pick L4 worms onto 4 x OP50-seeded NGM 90mm plates (10 worms per plate).

substeps.instruction: At 17:00, refeed L1s onto 5 x 150mm plates by dropping 4 small droplets around the edges of the plate (off food).

steps.title: Prepare Day 2 Synchronized Worms
steps.instruction: Perform bleach synchronization of C. elegans (Ida Barlow protocol, remixing pellet after each wash) for day 2 tracking.

substeps.instruction: Keep at 20 °C in rotator until refeeding.

steps.title: Prepare 96-well Agar Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare 1.5L low peptone NGM and autoclave.

substeps.instruction: Once agar has cooled and salts have been added, use a VIAFILL dispenser to pour 200 µL of agar per well into 65 x 96 well plates.
Once cooled, store lidside down in an airtight container at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dry Plates
steps.instruction: Place plates in the flow hood with lids off for 3 hours to allow to dry.
